subject: Please re-run schema-guard tests against updated RP exams
body: GF — GP completed a field audit and bulk fix of all 10 RP JSON files this sprint. 93 fields added (feedback_correct, feedback_wrong, version, solution_steps padding). 34 feedback_wrong strings trimmed to 12-word ADHD limit. Current verify: 3008/3008. GP tests (5 files): all pass. Requesting: re-run localstorage-schema-guard.test.js and schema-guard-all-rp.test.js to confirm no regressions from the field additions. If schema tests need updating to recognize new fields (feedback_correct, feedback_wrong), please update to include them as valid fields. GP baseline: tests/gp-field-completeness.test.js 900/900, tests/gp-feedback-length.test.js 300/300, tests/gp-answer-uniqueness.test.js 66/66. Let me know if any issues.
